objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A compact stockpile pile of gathered stones for a fantasy goblin settlement, arranged in a tidy but slightly irregular heap. Mixed chunks of rough stone in small to medium sizes, with angular and rounded shapes, stacked into a practical resource pile. Colours in cool greys, muted blue-grey, dusty brown-grey, and pale stone highlights, with subtle variation between pieces. A few stones show chipped edges and fractured surfaces. Designed as a stored building material for a cute underground colony sim. Whimsical dark fairy-tale aesthetic, cute fantasy pixel art, fixed three-quarter JRPG perspective, 32×32 sprite style, crisp pixel placement, thick clean black outlines, limited harmonious colour palette, subtle shading, clear readable silhouette, transparent background, isolated object, no scenery, no text.
